texts.facts: It is well established principle of law that in order to prosecute near and dear relatives of husband of the complainant, vague, general and omnibus statements are not sufficient and unless and until a specific allegation is made against near and dear relatives of husband of complainant, they may not be compelled to face ordeal of trial.
